original_ai_output.title_zh: 布隆迪总统在非盟峰会称持续暴力阻碍非洲发展
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 布隆迪总统恩达伊施米耶在埃及阿拉曼举行的非洲联盟会议上表示，非洲各地持续不断的暴力正在损害农业、教育和发展。他提到刚果（金）和苏丹的局势是前所未有的人道主义灾难。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 布隆迪总统恩达伊施米耶在埃及阿拉曼举行的非盟会议上发言
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Evariste Ndayishimiye was speaking at the Alamein Africa Forum, attended by heads of state and business leaders from across the continent.

key_facts.fact: 恩达伊施米耶称持续暴力损害非洲农业、教育和发展
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Persistent violence across Africa is taking a toll on farming, education and development, Burundi’s President told leaders at an African Union meeting in Egypt.

key_facts.fact: 他称刚果（金）和苏丹的暴力是前所未有的人道主义灾难
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In DRC, in Sudan, it is an unprecedented humanitarian catastrophe.

uncertainties: 该报道目前仅有一个来源（Africanews），尚缺乏交叉验证
